_meta.name: Suicide Rate, Ages 25–44
_meta.unit: deaths per 100,000 people in the age group (crude)
_meta.source: CDC/NCHS National Vital Statistics System (Health, United States + Data Query System)
_meta.note: Suicide deaths (ICD-10 U03, X60–X84, Y87.0; ICD-8/9 equivalents before 1999) per 100,000 resident population aged 25-44, crude rate. 1950–2018 from the Health, United States 2019 table (1950/1960/1970 then annual from 1980), 2018 onward from the NCHS Data Query System table built from CDC WONDER; the 2018 overlap agrees. The all-ages, age-adjusted series is a separate row.
_meta.method: 9j2v-jamp (stub_name Age, '25-44 years', crude) + w26f-tf3h (group 'Age group', '25-44 years')
